records.title: Signature mismatch: composeStory
records.remediation: Update the documented signature of `composeStory` from `(story: StoryAnnotationsOrFn<ReactRenderer, TArgs>, componentAnnotations: Meta<TArgs | any>, projectAnnotations?: ProjectAnnotations<ReactRenderer>, exportsName?: string): ComposedStoryFn<ReactRenderer, Partial<TArgs>>` to `composeStory<TRenderer extends Renderer = Renderer, TArgs extends Args = Args>(storyAnnotations: LegacyStoryAnnotationsOrFn<TRenderer>, componentAnnotations: ComponentAnnotations<TRenderer, TArgs>, projectAnnotations?: ProjectAnnotations<TRenderer>, defaultConfig?: ProjectAnnotations<TRenderer>, exportsName?: string): ComposedStoryFn<TRenderer, Partial<TArgs>>`, the signature the source defines at `code/core/src/preview-api/modules/store/csf/portable-stories.ts:90`.
records.issue: documented `(story: StoryAnnotationsOrFn<ReactRenderer, TArgs>, componentAnnotations: Meta<TArgs | any>, projectAnnotations?: ProjectAnnotations<ReactRenderer>, exportsName?: string): ComposedStoryFn<ReactRenderer, Partial<TArgs>>`, source `composeStory<TRenderer extends Renderer = Renderer, TArgs extends Args = Args>(storyAnnotations: LegacyStoryAnnotationsOrFn<TRenderer>, componentAnnotations: ComponentAnnotations<TRenderer, TArgs>, projectAnnotations?: ProjectAnnotations<TRenderer>, defaultConfig?: ProjectAnnotations<TRenderer>, exportsName?: string): ComposedStoryFn<TRenderer, Partial<TArgs>>`: The core declaration has five positional params with defaultConfig at position 4 and exportsName at position 5, while the documented four-param form (the React wrapper at code/renderers/react/src/portable-stories.tsx:L106) puts exportsName at position 4, so passing it fourth to this export would bind it to defaultConfig.

records.title: Signature mismatch: composeStories
records.remediation: Update the documented signature of `composeStories` from `(csfExports: TModule, projectAnnotations?: ProjectAnnotations<ReactRenderer>): Omit<StoriesWithPartialProps<ReactRenderer, TModule>, keyof Store_CSFExports>` to `composeStories<TModule extends Store_CSFExports>(storiesImport: TModule, globalConfig: ProjectAnnotations<Renderer>, composeStoryFn: ComposeStoryFn = defaultComposeStory) — no annotated return (inferred {} from the reduce)`, the signature the source defines at `code/core/src/preview-api/modules/store/csf/portable-stories.ts:274`.
records.issue: documented `(csfExports: TModule, projectAnnotations?: ProjectAnnotations<ReactRenderer>): Omit<StoriesWithPartialProps<ReactRenderer, TModule>, keyof Store_CSFExports>`, source `composeStories<TModule extends Store_CSFExports>(storiesImport: TModule, globalConfig: ProjectAnnotations<Renderer>, composeStoryFn: ComposeStoryFn = defaultComposeStory) — no annotated return (inferred {} from the reduce)`: This core declaration (the storybook/preview-api export) requires its second parameter globalConfig (documented as optional), takes a third optional composeStoryFn, and returns the un-cast reduce result rather than Omit<StoriesWithPartialProps<...>>; the documented form is the React renderer wrapper at code/renderers/react/src/portable-stories.tsx:L148, not this declaration.

records.title: Signature mismatch: mocked
records.remediation: Update the documented signature of `mocked` from `(item: T, options?: { partial?: boolean; deep?: boolean }) => MaybeMocked<T>` to `overloads: mocked<T>(item: T, deep?: false): MaybeMocked<T>; mocked<T>(item: T, deep: true): MaybeMockedDeep<T>; mocked<T>(item: T, options: { partial?: false; deep?: false }): MaybeMocked<T>; mocked<T>(item: T, options: { partial?: false; deep: true }): MaybeMockedDeep<T>; mocked<T>(item: T, options: { partial: true; deep?: false }): MaybePartiallyMocked<T>; mocked<T>(item: T, options: { partial: true; deep: true }): MaybePartiallyMockedDeep<T>; mocked<T>(item: T): MaybeMocked<T>`, the signature the source defines at `code/core/src/test/spy.ts:119`.
records.issue: documented `(item: T, options?: { partial?: boolean; deep?: boolean }) => MaybeMocked<T>`, source `overloads: mocked<T>(item: T, deep?: false): MaybeMocked<T>; mocked<T>(item: T, deep: true): MaybeMockedDeep<T>; mocked<T>(item: T, options: { partial?: false; deep?: false }): MaybeMocked<T>; mocked<T>(item: T, options: { partial?: false; deep: true }): MaybeMockedDeep<T>; mocked<T>(item: T, options: { partial: true; deep?: false }): MaybePartiallyMocked<T>; mocked<T>(item: T, options: { partial: true; deep: true }): MaybePartiallyMockedDeep<T>; mocked<T>(item: T): MaybeMocked<T>`: The declaration at L119 takes a boolean-literal second parameter `deep?: false` (not an options object), and the overload set returns MaybeMockedDeep/MaybePartiallyMocked/MaybePartiallyMockedDeep when deep or partial is true, whereas the documented signature collapses this into one options-object form that always returns MaybeMocked<T>.
